_note: Fundamentals-based 3-yr target with buybacks. Each scenario links a DCF; payout mode rolls that DCF's opening net cash and shares forward: FCFF (+ cash_yield on net cash) accumulates, buyback_share / dividend_share of positive FCFF is paid out, and repurchased shares retire at the repurchase_price path ('market' = today's price rolled at cost_of_equity − dividend_yield; 'intrinsic' = value-neutral; or a list). annual_dilution stays 0 when SBC is expensed in the DCF. A real run gives each scenario its own DCF file.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.assumptions: buybacks 70% of FCF (3-yr average), dividends 10%, SBC expensed in the DCF
